# Code Anchors: Sprint Goals

- `backend/internal/handler/goal.go` — the goal write: origin and token checks, the caller's role from GitHub, the sprint check, the cap, one goal record written or deleted
- `backend/internal/handler/goal_test.go` — goal write tests: refusals, editor role, unknown sprint, cap, single-record writes
- `backend/internal/handler/handler.go` — routes the goal write when sign-in and the store are configured
- `backend/internal/handler/sync.go` — adds the goal records and the may-edit flag to the sync answer
- `libs/app/src/goals.ts` — sends the goal write through the gateway, trims the text to one line under the cap, names the failure cause
- `libs/app/src/goalcard.tsx` — the goal on a sprint card: plain text, or the goal field with Saving, Not saved and Try again, one write at a time
- `libs/app/src/goals.test.tsx` — goal field, save on leaving, one write in flight, failure and retry, read-only text
- `libs/app/src/bands.tsx` — places each sprint's goal on its card
- `libs/app/src/groomingsync.ts` — reads the goals and the may-edit flag from the sync answer
- `libs/app/src/app.css` — goal field, goal text and save-state styles
- `libs/app/src/testing/fakegraph.ts` — a fake backend that stores goals for the tests
- `docs/setup/github-app.md` — the goal route, its role check and its table permissions
